descriptionChirho: The raqia, the expanse or vault of the sky created by God in Genesis 1 and referenced in Ezekiel, Daniel, and the Psalms. All four clusters denote the same cosmological concept with only grammatical variation (construct chains, articles, prepositions, bare noun). Multilingual glosses confirm uniform meaning: English 'expanse/firmament', Spanish 'expansion/firmamento', Hindi 'thoss-vistar/akashmandal' (solid-expanse/sky-sphere), Arabic 'jalad/falak' (firmament/celestial sphere), Korean 'gungchang/changkong' (vault/firmament), Swahili 'anga' (sky/firmament) uniformly across all 17 occurrences.
